text_block_list.text: —A few days before the Make Debut.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Good, good.
Preparation for a full-power sprint is all set.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh, seems we have a few
spectators scattered around today?
choice_data_list: Yeah, this might be the perfect chance to show off.
Yeah, might be the perfect chance to show what you've got.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
*Grin.*
Well then... time to go give 'em a good scare.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: Ooooohh?!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text: "This time is...?! It rivals that of a Senior Class Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Transcend... is quite something.
How on earth is she running like this...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Fufufun-fu... None of them know yet.
Just how dangerous it is when Trai-chan and I team up.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Yeah, if we put our strength together—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trai-chan. Found a new research paper.
Supposedly by an American authority on sports science.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Well? Think you can incorporate this stuff nicely?
choice_data_list: Let's see, I'll take a quick look.
Let's see, I'll take a quick look.

text_block_list.text:
I carefully scrutinize the latest info Transcend has dug up,
adopting only what is necessary.

"Through this cycle, Transcend's running
was refined right before our eyes."

At this stage, her running in training
is remarkable. All that's left is—
(Murmur, murmur, murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Uhyaa, it's finally here: the Make a Debut.
To tell you the truth, though...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Maybe you don't need to be so anxious.
Today is just, you know,
going to turn out the way it was meant to.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep. I gathered the info. And then, Train-chan,
you used it to decide how to run the race, didn't you?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I've shared the race plan.
Yeah, I told you the race plan, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Then after that,
all that's left is to run according to the flow, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
As long as we watch out for trouble,
there's no way things can go south.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
That's just how it goes.
Who knows about the big races down the road,
but at this stage, there's no real thrill or major blunders.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Well, just watch. I'll cross the finish line with the exact running style and the exact time we planned.

It seemed a little too optimistic.
Still, if things go according to plan,
nothing could be better.

How will the results turn out?
And thus—

Transcend dived right into
a pre-established harmony of a future.
